card.name: Section number after cross-reference title
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis, "Section", or "under" right after a section title in a bracketed cross-reference such as "see Warnings and Precautions". It also fires on the dot inside a section number like 5.3.

modes.label: Parenthesis before section number
modes.description: An opening bracket right after a named label section, just before the number.

modes.label: Word introducing the reference
modes.description: "Section" or "under" follows the cited section title.
modes.example: See dose modifications in<< Section>> 2.2 ( Dose Modification

modes.label: Dot inside section number
modes.description: The decimal point within a number such as 5.3 in a cross-reference.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label's cross-reference where the section number is about to appear.
